title: Expose window.__GAME_STATE__ with scene + player position
description: Introduce a runtime inspector system that writes a JSON-serializable snapshot to window.__GAME_STATE__ each frame, including the active scene name and player x/y.
acceptance: window.__GAME_STATE__ exposes { scene: string, player: {x:number,y:number}, ready: boolean }
Snapshot updates at least once per second while the game runs
outOfScope: Do not include NPCs, dialogue, or map state yet
